key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

output.summary: Make a wooden phone stand for a desk

needs.why: To cut and shape wood for the stand
To cut flat wooden pieces accurately

ways_considered.reason: The student wants wood, not plastic

ways_considered.process: Laser cutting pieces from plywood and slotting them together
ways_considered.reason: Fits the student's wood choice and is easy to assemble

routes.process: Cut flat pieces from plywood and slot them together
routes.fit_reason: This route uses a laser cutter to make precise wooden parts that easily fit together. It is a great choice for a beginner.

steps.title: Design the parts
steps.detail: Draw flat interlocking pieces for your phone stand on a computer.

steps.title: Complete safety training
steps.detail: Take the required orientation and safety training before using the space.

steps.title: Cut the wood
steps.detail: Ask staff to check your file, then use the laser cutter to cut your pieces.

steps.title: Assemble the stand
steps.detail: Slot the wooden pieces together to form your phone stand.

warnings.issue: The wood might be too thin and bend under the phone's weight.

output.single_route_reason: Only the Baum Family Maker Space has the laser cutting equipment and wood materials needed for this project.
